concerns.text: No task creates the `contracts/trial_log.schema.yaml` file required by the Single Source of Truth (Constitution IV). Add a task (e.g., T040‑contract‑create) that generates/validates this schema.
The plan references a `data-model.md` artifact, but there is no task that defines or validates the data model entities. Add a task (e.g., T041‑data‑model‑define) to produce this document.
A `quickstart.md` is listed in the project structure, yet no task creates it. Add a task (e.g., T042‑quickstart‑write) to author the quick‑start guide.
The Analyze report flags missing citation‑validation tasks. Include a task (e.g., T043‑citation‑validate) that invokes the Reference‑Validator Agent to check all external citations.
